intro: GTA 6 is set in Leonida, Rockstar's take on Florida. Rockstar has named six destinations so far, from the neon of Vice City to the swamps and backwoods up north. Everything here comes from official descriptions; the full map arrives with the game.

sources.title: Rockstar Games – Grand Theft Auto VI official site
Gematsu – Trailer 2, characters and places detailed (reproduces Rockstar's descriptions)

items.name: Vice City
about: Vice City is the sunny, glamorous and greedy heart of Leonida.
Its neighbourhoods range from Art Deco hotels and white sand at Ocean Beach to the bakeries of Little Cuba, the Tisha-Wocka flea market, and VC Port, a major cruise hub.

spots.name: Ocean Beach
spots.note: Art Deco hotels and white sand. The pre-order pack's garage sits here.

spots.name: Tisha-Wocka flea market
spots.note: Named by Rockstar as a local landmark.

spots.name: Washington Beach
spots.note: Where the Ultimate Edition's Shitzu Squalo boat is docked.

spots.name: Stockyard
spots.note: Home to the Stock 305 streetwear store and the Electric Fang tattoo bar (Ultimate Edition).

spots.name: Southside
spots.note: The PTT Youngin$ gang compound (Ultimate Edition raid).

items.name: Leonida Keys
about: A chain of tropical islands with a slow pace of life and plenty of good bars.
The water is beautiful, but Rockstar warns it is also dangerous. This is where Jason lives and works.

spots.name: Brian Heder's boat yard
spots.note: Run by Brian and Lori. Jason lives on one of Brian's properties.

items.name: Grassrivers
about: A vast wetland and the most untamed corner of the state.
Alligators are the famous attraction, but Rockstar hints at worse predators and stranger things hidden among the mangroves.

items.name: Port Gellhorn
items.tagline: A holiday town that's seen better days.
about: Once a popular stretch of vacation coast, Port Gellhorn has slid into decline.
Empty motels and closed-down attractions have made way for a shadow economy running on malt liquor, painkillers and cheap energy drinks.

items.name: Ambrosia
items.tagline: A company town with a biker problem.
about: An industrial town built around the Allied Crystal sugar refinery, which supplies most of the local jobs.
Most of what the refinery doesn't control belongs to a local biker gang.

items.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
about: A huge, remote park in the north of Leonida with hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
Its backwoods are home to isolated, suspicious and sometimes mystical locals who want nothing to do with the government.

spots.name: Mud Club off-road trails
spots.note: The Ultimate Edition's '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy is built for them.
